selected_rules.name: Pre-drift High-Risk Pincode COD with Value Cap
selected_rules.code:
import pandas as pd

def predict(df: pd.DataFrame):
    # Authentic Pre-drift Baseline Rule:
    # Targets high historical pincode RTO rate on COD orders for first-time customers
    # with modest order value (minimizing false alarm merchant margin insult).
    return (
        (df['payment_mode'] == 'COD') &
        (df['pincode_rolling_rto_rate'] >= 0.40) &
        (df['is_first_time_customer'] == True) &
        (df['order_value'] <= 1000)
    )
selected_rules.description: Pre-drift baseline rule evolved on orders_train targeting high historical pincode RTO on COD first-time orders.
selected_rules.rationale: Prior to drift, fraud concentrated in known high-risk pincodes with COD payment from first-time users.

selected_rules.name: Low-Value Electronics/Fashion COD in High-RTO Pincode
selected_rules.description: Captures inexpensive electronics or fashion COD orders in high-RTO pincodes.
selected_rules.rationale: Fraudsters often target cheap, high-turnover items (e.g., gadgets, accessories) delivered via COD to avoid immediate payment. Combining category with a high-RTO pincode amplifies the risk signal while keeping order value low.
